letter_deductions.deduction: Claim not admissible: The medicines claimed (telmisartan, metformin, atorvastatin and glucometer strips) are for long-term blood pressure and diabetes care, not for the acute appendicitis treated under claim CLM-2026-00397. Post-hospitalisation cover applies only to expenses for the same condition, so these outpatient purchases are not payable.
letter_deductions.why: Matches: post-hospitalisation cover is for the same condition only.
